diagnostics.sourceOfTruth: MS-VBAL 3.3.1
MS-VBAL 5.4.2.1 plus asserted Excel/VBE oracle cases plus deterministic project signature graph
diagnostics.notes: Same-module signatures come from the AST, including external Declare metadata. Cross-module checks run only for exported standard-module Sub/Function/Declare signatures supplied by ProjectIndex. Ambiguous bare exported names stay silent; module-qualified calls resolve through the named standard module only. Named-argument checks report unknown parameter names and duplicate named parameters case-insensitively, with duplicate behavior backed by the VBE oracle's Named argument already specified compile error. PCEC_008 + omitted-after-named: nothing positional may follow a named argument - VBE rejects at compile (regardless of the signature) both a positional VALUE after a named arg (oracle positional_after_named_argument_compile, plus the paren-call and ParamArray forms positional_after_named_paren_call_compile / positional_after_named_paramarray_compile) AND an omitted/empty slot after a named arg (oracle omit_trailing_after_named_compile f(a:=1, ) and omit_middle_between_named_compile f(a:=1, , c:=3)). Pure slot-order syntax (independent of the resolved signature): once a named slot is seen, the FIRST subsequent non-named slot is the violation (a positional value or an omitted slot). Omissions BEFORE the first named arg stay legal (oracle omit_leading_before_named_compile f(, b:=2), omit_positional_then_omit_then_named_compile f(1, , c:=3), and the omission-without-named baseline omit_baseline_no_named_compile f(1, , 3)), as do the legal positional-then-named and all-named orderings (positional_then_named_argument_ok_compile / named_then_named_argument_ok_compile). Runs inside validateArity, so it is naturally scoped to resolved callees (unknown callees stay silent - an accepted no-FP false negative). Source-backed and host member signatures are validated through the shared member binder for parenthesized calls and parenless member call statements, including leading-dot calls inside simple or nested With receiver stacks. Bare runtime signatures are runtime-last and stay silent when visible non-callable source names shadow the runtime name. Issue #223: a list ending in an empty argument (Opt(1, ), TwoSub 1,) is a Syntax error whatever the parameters, Print excepted; a named ParamArray is refused. Issue #224: a class property whose Get takes a required index, used without one (Argument not optional), and a Public field of a value type given arguments (Wrong number of arguments; as a Let target, Can't assign to read-only property). Issue #410: named arguments that leave a required parameter without one, TTwo a:=1, are Argument not optional. Issue #318: a VBA library procedure that needs an argument, named bare where a value goes (TypeName(Left), Main = Kill, Seek), is Argument not optional. Issue #304: a local Collection's Add (1 to 4), Item and Remove (1) and Count (0), a bare Excel Global method against its signature, bare Cells (at most 2) and Range (1 or 2), and a numeric host property given an argument.

diagnostics.sourceOfTruth: Excel/VBE compile and runtime oracle plus deterministic XLIDE literal, return-type, numeric-expression, string-concatenation, and project signature model
diagnostics.notes: This is not a VBE compile-equivalent error: the focused compile oracle case compiles successfully. It is red because focused runtime oracle cases deterministically raise runtime error 13 for nonnumeric string literals passed to numeric parameters and intrinsic CVErr Error Variants passed to scalar parameters, runtime error 94 for Null passed to scalar parameters, and runtime error 6 for decimal literals outside Byte/Integer/Long/Currency argument bounds, while numeric-string, Variant CVErr, Variant Null, and min/max boundary controls run successfully. Cross-module checks use exported standard-module project Sub/Function/Declare signatures; ambiguous bare names stay silent, while module-qualified calls resolve through the named standard module only. Source-backed and host member signatures feed the same argument type path for parenthesized calls and parenless member call statements, including leading-dot calls inside simple or nested With receiver stacks. Argument inference also consumes bare local/module/unique-exported value declarations resolved through the shared expression resolver, module-qualified source-backed value reads such as ModuleName.ValueName, zero-argument Function/Property Get value references, Null literals, intrinsic CVErr Error Variant returns when not source-shadowed, explicit VBA.CVErr calls, and proven source-backed/host member return expressions when source/project/runtime/member metadata proves the return type. Runtime parameter and return metadata is skipped for bare names shadowed by visible source declarations, including untyped locals. Issue #223: Array(...) or Split(...) into a Long or String parameter, and an object expression of another class into a typed object parameter (TakeWs(Range("A1"))), raise 13; a negative float literal past the Long range raises 6. A float literal past LongLong's range into a LongLong or LongPtr parameter, Take(1E+19), raises 6 (issue #232, 64-bit Excel 16.0). Issue #242: Sgn(Null) raises 94; Abs, Int and Hex pass Null through (measured in Excel 16.0). Issue #246: a declared object variable known to hold another class, from Set p = New C, passed ByVal or ByRef raises 13 when the call runs; one still Nothing passes (measured in Excel 16.0). Issue #266: RaiseEvent to a ByVal Event parameter of a number type: a string that is no number raises 13 (RaiseEvent Done("abc")), and a whole number outside the type raises 6 (40000 for an Integer). Measured in Excel 16.0. Issue #329: CBool, CByte, CCur, CDate, CDbl, CDec, CInt, CLng, CLngLng and CSng given Null raise 94, as CStr does; CVar keeps the Null.

diagnostics.sourceOfTruth: Excel/VBE compile oracle plus deterministic XLIDE source-backed callable signatures and shared expression value resolver
diagnostics.notes: The active rule is intentionally narrow: it fires only when a source-backed same-module or unique exported project callable has a ByRef parameter with a known exact type and the argument is an unparenthesized known non-Variant variable with a different normalized type. diagnostics.sourceOfTruth: Excel/VBE compile and runtime oracle plus deterministic XLIDE scalar assignment compatibility model
diagnostics.notes: This is not a VBE compile-equivalent error: focused compile oracle cases compile successfully. It is red when XLIDE proves a value cannot be coerced or fit into the target scalar type because focused runtime oracle cases deterministically raise runtime error 13 for type mismatch, runtime error 94 for Null assigned to scalar targets, and runtime error 6 for decimal Byte/Integer/Long/Currency overflow, while numeric/string/Boolean/property/public-field, Variant CVErr, Variant Null, and min/max boundary controls run successfully. Function, Property Get return-name assignments, and visible exported standard-module scalar globals use the same deterministic scalar path. Bare assignment targets ask the shared assignment-target resolver first, so local untyped shadows and ambiguous exported globals suppress type guessing. Intrinsic CVErr calls infer an Error Variant for scalar assignment compatibility when the bare runtime name is not source-shadowed, explicit VBA.CVErr remains runtime-bound, and Null literals infer the dedicated Null value type. Issue #222: a Function declared As Variant whose every assignment to its name is Array(...) returns Variant() or Empty, and into an array of another element type raises 13. Issue #239: a Variant local whose last straight-line assignment is Null, assigned to a String, Long or other scalar, raises 94 (v = Null then s = v). Measured in Excel 16.0 (build 20326), issue239_* oracle cases. Issue #243: a Choose, Switch or IIf whose literal arguments make it return Null, into a typed variable, raises 94: Choose(5, 1, 2), Choose(0, "a"), Switch(False, 1), IIf(False, 1, Null) (measured in Excel 16.0, build 20326, issue243_* oracle cases). Issue #255: a Const whose value is one string literal converts as the literal does: Const K = "abc" into a Long raises 13, Const K = "40000" into an Integer 6 (measured in Excel 16.0). A String the analyzer knows a local or an array element holds is checked like a literal (measured in Excel 16.0, 2026-10-01): s = "b" then n = s with n As Long, v = "b" with v a Variant, and v(1) of v = Array("1", "b") raise 13; "5", " 2 ", "&H10", "1e3" and "$5" convert. Past 12/31/9999 or before 1/1/100 it raises 13. Issue #405: a String expression the analyzer can spell out, a & chain of literals, known locals, True and False, and Left, Right, Mid, UCase, LCase, Trim, LTrim, RTrim and CStr over them, is checked into a Boolean, a number or a Date like a literal; a Date written as text never converts to a number or a Boolean. Text a locale's currency symbol might explain (True5, x1) is left alone, as #188 leaves a literal. Issue #457: Chr, Hex, Oct, Space, String and StrConv over literals are spelled out, and MonthName, WeekdayName, Format of a Date literal as a month or day name, TypeName, a Range Address and Application.Name or PathSeparator stand for a word no locale reads as a number, a Boolean or a date: into a Long, Double, Boolean or Date each raises 13. Issue #451: a String * n local named nowhere else holds n Chr(0), which raise 13 into a Long, Double, Boolean or Date. Issue #436: a variable As an Enum is a Long, so x = "abc" raises 13 and x = 3000000000# raises 6. Issue #324: Null after an operator into a typed target raises 94: arithmetic, +, unary minus, Not, a comparison and Abs give Null; And gives Null unless the other side is False, Or unless it is True; & never does. Issue #448: n = F() with F a Function of the module whose only result is a literal: a string that is no number (13) or Null (94) into a typed target.
